attributes.title: 2027 NJLN Convention and Pre-Convention
attributes.summary:
The New Jersey League for Nursing holds its 2027 Convention and Pre-Convention on Wednesday, March 31, and Thursday, April 1, 2027, at Harrah's Resort in Atlantic City. The theme is "The Art & Science of Nursing: Where Knowledge, Compassion, and Leadership Converge."

The first day opens with a full-day Pre-Convention Nurse Educator Program for faculty, clinical nurse educators and nursing education students, followed by an evening keynote. The main convention on April 1 is aimed at nurses and healthcare leaders at every career stage, from New Jersey and neighboring states.

NJLN says attendees can earn contact hours but has not posted the number or the fees; registration was marked as opening soon when we checked, and registrations are non-refundable. Hotel rates at Harrah's apply to reservations made by March 9.
